analysis.title: Playful Cosmic Origins Poster
analysis.notes: A muted sage background supports an oversized cream headline, colorful planets, orbital curves, and scattered blue particles. Small navigation details and outlined lettering create an exploratory editorial interface with a playful cosmic mood.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a wide editorial landing-page hero in a playful retro-futurist illustration style: a muted sage-gray space background filled with sparse electric-blue specks, sweeping thin orbital paths, and floating glossy abstract planets in coral, violet, cyan, and pink. Place a huge centered two-line cream headline in a heavy rounded grotesk, with tiny widely spaced chapter text above and small navigation labels along the bottom. Add subtle grain, hand-drawn imperfections, thin dark outlines, and generous negative space around the central type. No logos, no recognizable characters, and no extra readable words beyond minimal abstract interface marks.
